info.title: Proposed objective import and collection policy extension
info.description: Eight unimplemented operations outside the 74 canonical APIs and the seven earlier proposed objective operations. Not deployed or engine tested.
info.x-contract-review: Implementation review 1; typed response addendum, not a deployed handler

post.description: PROPOSED extension only. Derive tenant environment actor and ingestion time from authenticated server context; body fields are not authority. Resolve connection IDs through approved scoped connector configuration, never arbitrary URLs or credentials. Recheck current source grants, workload mapping, normalizer and objective/template permissions. Mutations require durable idempotency and expected revisions; commit candidate/resolution/proposal or policy, audit and outbox atomically. Return metadata receipts, not activation or runtime success. Detect duplicate content and changed-content conflicts. Recheck source/local digests before proposal admission. A source update never silently overwrites or activates an objective; existing distinct review and effective activation remain required. Paginate history after authorization with a scope-bound cursor. Reconciliation is bounded, quota-aware and resumable; missing rows do not imply source withdrawal. Imported definitions cannot supply or weaken organization template rules. Preserve comparison direction, percentile semantics and measurement window. Proposal admission checks exact approved template version and rejects target/range/unit conflicts. Responses follow implementation_review/response.schema.json or the named existing domain schema. Authentication, field disclosure, serializers and running handlers still require implementation and acceptance.
